acceptance_criteria.description: Mirror tooling lives outside MagentaBench protocol packages and classifies as repository operations code.
The move preserves mirror identities, receipts, CLI behavior, and focused verification.
The placement lease owns only tools/mirror_acquisition; existing mirror scope owns deletions and documentation updates.

objective: Keep digest-bound mirror tooling mergeable as repository operations code without changing BMP package surfaces.
title: Place mirror acquisition outside the BMP protocol package
